- Rebuilt as a native Windows app: the installer is about 2.5 MB instead of 78 MB.
- New dark interface with the Windows 11 Mica material, denser layouts and a bigger file list.
- Downloads now always go to the folder currently set in Settings, even if you changed it while a scan was running. The destination is shown during and after the download.
- Progress, speed and time left now come from the app itself, so they match what is really being saved. Skipped and failed files are counted, and a retried file is not counted twice.
- The file list can be sorted by name, type, size or course.
- Course text is off by default, and the course settings are now labelled as a filter.
- A smooth 60 fps background animation that pauses when the window is not in focus.
- Sign-in uses plain HTTP first and falls back to a built-in browser window when Blackboard needs one.
- Batch Automation is not part of this release yet.
- You need to enter your saved password once more after upgrading from 1.x.
